status_note: Rejected at Roc's gate 2026-08-04. Kept on record, not deleted.
learn_source: Watch the baker coax a slow batch at the counter in the Town scene — the feast needs every proof on time whatever the weather does
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on a cold thing once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the heat is even to the centre; at baseline the surface warms faster than the core. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: State-dependent: underproofed, it rises on schedule; already fully risen, it over-proofs and sags — warmth is not a cure-all
Warms through and holds the heat a while — a bed-warmer or a proofing stone
no_effect — the mass is too great; the heat vanishes into it without registering
No physical effect — the warmth does not attach to a living body
receivers.reaction_kind: sniffs the warmed air near the cast point, circles, settles nearby
